verdict.rationale: Cekura's observability pipeline ingests production call transcripts into CallLogs and schedules metric evaluation (cekura-docs-6/25), and it offers rich evaluation primitives (LLM judge, python metrics, rubrics, sampling) that could be applied to that data (cekura-docs-8,9,24,32), but there is no explicit documentation of curating a dataset from production traces or running a distinct 'offline evaluation' pass against a saved dataset — evaluation appears tied to live/scheduled call scoring rather than dataset-based offline eval workflows. missing for 10: explicit dataset-curation/export feature from production traces, documented offline-eval-against-dataset workflow, evidence of dataset versioning or reuse for benchmarking.
